description: Defines the 'Client' class and related classes for client-side service API in the 'android::pdx' namespace, including methods for connection management, remote method invocation, resource handling, and auto-reconnection.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Base class for client-side service API, managing connection, resource handling, and remote method invocation.

classes.name: ClientBase
classes.description: Template utility class for client API classes, handling initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Final class for managing resource transactions over a client connection, including sending and receiving data, and resource mapping.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the client instance was successfully initialized.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error code from the last failure, or 0 if none.

methods.name: GetChannelHandle
methods.description: Returns a reference to the IPC channel handle.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Hook called after successful connection, can be overridden for additional setup.

methods.name: SendImpulse
methods.description: Sends an impulse message with an opcode, optionally with a buffer.

methods.name: InvokeRemoteMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method using pdx serialization, with return type.

methods.name: InvokeRemoteMethodInPlace
methods.description: Invokes a remote method and stores the result in a provided variable.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the client connection, optionally with an error code.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: EnableAutoReconnect
methods.description: Enables auto-reconnection with a specified timeout.

methods.name: DisableAutoReconnect
methods.description: Disables auto-reconnection.

methods.name: event_fd
methods.description: Returns a file descriptor for asynchronous notifications.

methods.name: GetChannel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying ClientChannel.

methods.name: TakeChannel
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the channel.

methods.name: PushFileHandle
methods.description: Pushes a file handle resource into the transaction.

methods.name: PushChannelHandle
methods.description: Pushes a channel handle resource into the transaction.

methods.name: GetFileHandle
methods.description: Retrieves a local handle from a resource reference.

methods.name: GetChannelHandle
methods.description: Retrieves a local channel handle from a resource reference.

methods.name: SendTransaction
methods.description: Internal method to send a transaction with specified opcode and resources.

methods.name: CheckDisconnect
methods.description: Checks and handles disconnection based on error code.
